name: USDU Finance
oneLiner: USDU is USDU Finance's DAO-minted dollar backed by Morpho and Curve vault shares after a sharp supply wind-down.
collateral: Adapter-held positions include Curve LP in the USDU/CHFU, USDU/EURU and USDU/USDC pools, USDU-denominated Morpho/TermMax claims, and reviewed USDC/USDT ERC-4626 positions in SwapBridgeMorphoV1 modules. The issuer's legacy backing API does not establish a complete all-module allocation.
pegMechanism: Protocol-minted via DAO-approved adapters; secondary-market conversion and reviewed USDC/USDT swap modules provide liquidity-dependent exits with nominal-parity accounting.

notices.title: Incomplete current backing disclosure
notices.message: The issuer's backing API reports legacy Curve, TermMax and Morpho totals, but does not identify every current and historical residual module or reconcile them to total USDU liabilities. Its displayed collateralization ratio is not a verified whole-book measure.

notices.title: Conflicting issuer disclosures
notices.message: USDU's transparency page and protocol-minting docs describe different issuance paths from the reviewed USDC/USDT swap modules. Complete current backing allocation, external valuation and liability reconciliation remain unresolved; the incomplete dashboard alone establishes neither full collateralization nor a reserve shortfall.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: USDU Finance's exact Ethereum ERC-20 0xdde3ec717f220fc6a29d6a4be73f91da5b718e55 is a protocol-position liability, not a direct fiat or borrower-CDP claim. Issuer disclosure identifies adapter-owned Curve LP and lending-vault shares; independently verified Ethereum block 26098837 establishes three valid modules, including user-callable USDC/USDT SwapBridgeMorphoV1 exits. Fresh block 26099926 confirms those three remain valid and their deployed runtime matches verified source. Holder rights are operational and conditional on module/vault resources; complete external asset valuation, matching liabilities, residual module allocation, custody and funded recovery remain unresolved.
